name: Time Traveler
source:
"The young Mizuno Mai is the result of a relationship between a spirit and a human being.
From the beginning of her life, she has been trapped in some misterious and curious worlds defended by some living beings called "Guardians." Her birth broke god's rules and her grandfather will be chasing her to erase her exsistence and everything around her as part of a personal revenge. Because of that, and with a bit of help, she will be able to travel to the past, present and future, and grow in a lot of ways to face her fears."

[From [url=https://commodorette.itch.io/timetraveler]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“年轻的水野麻衣是精神与人类之间关系的结果。
从她生命的一开始，她就被困在一些神秘而好奇的世界里，这些世界由一些被称为“守护者”的生物守护着。她的出生违反了神的规则，她的祖父将追捕她，抹去她的存在和她周围的一切，作为个人复仇的一部分。正因为如此，在一点帮助下，她将能够穿越到过去、现在和未来，并在很多方面成长来面对她的恐惧。”

[来自[url=https://commodorette.itch.io/timetraveler]Itch.io[/url]]
